CRITSFUMBLES.Title: Crits & Fumbles
CRITSFUMBLES.NotYours: Only the player who made the attack, or a GM, can roll this.
CRITSFUMBLES.ChooseDamageType: Choose the damage type to roll on.
CRITSFUMBLES.DetectedHint: Highlighted options were detected on the attack.
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.AutoTrigger.Name: Roll automatically on a natural crit or fumble
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.AutoTrigger.Hint: When off, roll only from the toolbar button or a macro.
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.Prompt.Name: Ask for the damage type
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.Prompt.Ambiguous: Only when more than one type applies
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.Prompt.Never: Never — use the first type found
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.TurnLimit.Name: When a crit or fumble can trigger
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.TurnLimit.Hint: Reactions, opportunity attacks and legendary actions land on someone else's turn, so the two limited settings never fire on them.
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.TurnLimit.First: Only on the turn's first attack roll
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.TurnLimit.Once: Once each turn, on any attack
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.OutsideCombat.Name: Trigger outside combat
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.OutsideCombat.Hint: Applies whichever limit is set above. An attack out of combat rolls initiative anyway, so there is no turn to limit.
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.Debug.Name: Log attack rolls to the console
CRITSFUMBLES.Settings.Debug.Hint: Diagnostic. Prints the shape of every attack roll.
